_comment: Execution-result status mapping for the Reporter's TestLink sync (Phase 2 TG10). Maps a test case's run outcome to a TestLink execution status. The outcome key is one of the failure-analysis classification values, or one of the special outcomes: 'skipped' (automation_decision = skip), 'not_run' (NO evidence the case executed), or 'passed'. IMPORTANT (review finding I1): 'passed' must only ever come from positive execution evidence. The absence of a failure entry is NOT a pass -- a case that never ran, a manual case, and a case whose result was lost all look identical -- so the script's fallback is 'not_run'. The run-scoped execution ledger (Phase 5) is what will supply a real 'passed'. Human-editable; the Reporter/script MUST NOT hardcode any of this. TestLink statuses: Pass, Fail, Blocked, Not Run. See docs/testlink-integration.md section 6 and phase2-integrations.md TG10.
_default_comment: Used when an outcome key is not found in the map above (e.g. a future classification value). Blocked is the safe default — it flags the case for a human in TestLink rather than silently passing or failing it.

testlink_statuses._comment: Reference only: the TestLink reportTCResult status codes the names map to.
